content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Alignment of AI Ethics Frameworks for Global Education Policy
agenda_items: Establishment of working groups for policy recommendation drafting.
Discussion on challenges of implementing AI governance in diverse educational contexts.
Review of current international AI ethics guidelines in education.
key_decisions: Adopt principles from the UNESCO AI Ethics Recommendation as a foundational baseline.
Initiate a pilot study on AI impact assessment in educational institutions within the next period.
Prioritize data privacy and algorithmic transparency as core tenets of any educational AI framework.
Form an inter-agency working group to synthesize regional educational technology policies.
action_items: All attendees to review the preliminary framework draft and provide feedback by +7 days.
Dr. Anya Sharma to draft a comparative analysis of existing national AI education policies by +14 days.
Ms. Lena Petrova to coordinate outreach with key educational technology providers for input on practical implementation challenges within the next 3 weeks.
